subject.title: fix(gateway): session workspace reveal hangs on foreground opener

question: Should `sessions.files.reveal` and `config.openFile` share a canonical platform-opener helper before the two parallel Gateway fixes land?
rationale: Both open PRs implement the same detached Linux startup observation and bounded macOS/Windows launcher behavior, while the proper shared-versus-RPC-specific ownership boundary is a maintainer architecture choice.

options.title: Extract a shared lifecycle helper
options.body: Move the common platform-launch behavior behind one helper and retain only RPC-specific command selection and error presentation at each call site.

options.title: Keep lifecycle implementations separate
options.body: Land separate helpers only if maintainers document a concrete semantic difference that requires independent lifecycle ownership.

recommendation.title: Extract a shared lifecycle helper
recommendation.body: Move the common platform-launch behavior behind one helper and retain only RPC-specific command selection and error presentation at each call site.
